speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One bough. I allowed one. The girls would have dressed the close like a wood, and I did not allow it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is drooping, Mistress. Thursday's hawthorn does not hold a Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Let it droop. A custom is not a May game, and May Day is behind us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sermon ran long. I am not the man who counts the heads.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The bough is the one you allowed, Mistress. I did not bring another in.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nor am I counting heads today. I have a bowl to think of, and you have a lump under that cloak.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lump is a book. I will tell you at the stair, not in the porch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the porch is done. One bough. Do not improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. God keep you, Mistress.
